question: You are serving on an emergency planning team for a scenic region hosting a national outdoor festival. As thunderstorms approach, authorities must evacuate everyone to safety. There are three official evacuation locations, all reportedly equipped and expecting displaced guests: Blueberry Ridge (a woodland lodge), Green Valley (a campground center), and Red Lake (a lakeside community hall). Authorities stress that time is short—you must urgently advise all festival-goers which evacuation site to use. You know that routes to all three seem open, but heavy rain may have caused unexpected damage or hazards. Only one option is safe, accessible, and prepared for immediate evacuation. Your group must recommend the best location based on the latest information, aiming to maximize the number of people evacuated safely.
